race.comment: LIGHTHORSEMAN (14) can go one better after being beaten a neck at Goulburn last time. This looks no tougher and with improvement to come he looks the one to beat. BACIAMI (3) resumes with stronger form than most, having run in the LR Show A Heart at Eagle Farm before the break. The depth of form is there and a recent trial here should have him forward enough to play a major role. LIETA MARIA (8) is the debut runner with most appeal, fitted with first-time blinkers and coming off a solid second in her latest Sunny Coast Inner Track trial. ZOULINI (16) has plenty of scope for improvement and deserves some thought too. Something for the Multiples: BALLISTIC STAR (1) GODT PLAYED (15)
